summary: The linear strategy runs each task in lockstep across the batch, up to the fork limit, before moving to the next task; it was the default before strategy plugins.
questions: What is Ansible's default execution strategy?
How does linear strategy execute tasks?

answer_card.title: linear strategy
answer_card.answer_md: `strategy: linear` (classic default) runs each task across all hosts in the batch (up to `forks` at a time) before moving to the next task.
